description.p: Soplos Sys Cleaner scans the system for reclaimable disk space — APT cache, old kernels, unused drivers and firmware, unused languages and documentation, orphaned packages, system logs, temporary files, and Flatpak/Snap leftovers — and shows a clear preview of everything it found before removing anything. A basic program offers one standard cleanup, and an advanced one gives access to every page.

El Limpiador del Sistema de Soplos analiza el sistema en busca de espacio recuperable: caché de APT, núcleos antiguos, controladores y firmware sin usar, idiomas y manuales no utilizados, paquetes huérfanos, registros del sistema, archivos temporales y restos de Flatpak/Snap, mostrando una vista previa detallada antes de borrar nada. Incluye un modo básico con limpieza estándar en un clic y un modo avanzado con control total.

Le nettoyeur du système de Soplos recherche l'espace disque récupérable : cache APT, anciens noyaux, pilotes et microprogrammes inutilisés, langues et documentations inutilisées, paquets orphelins, journaux, fichiers temporaires et résidus Flatpak/Snap. Un programme simple propose un nettoyage standard et un mode avancé offre un contrôle total.

Die Soplos Systembereinigung analysiert das System auf freigebbaren Speicherplatz: APT-Cache, alte Kernel, ungenutzte Treiber und Firmware, nicht benötigte Sprachen, verwaiste Pakete, Protokolle, temporäre Dateien und Flatpak/Snap-Reste mit einer präzisen Vorschau vor jeder Bereinigung. Beinhaltet ein Standard-Programm sowie einen erweiterten Modus mit allen Detailseiten.

O utilitário de Limpeza do Sistema do Soplos analisa o sistema em busca de espaço recuperável: cache APT, kernels antigos, controladores e firmware não utilizados, idiomas e manuais secundários, pacotes órfãos, registos do sistema, ficheiros temporários e resíduos de Flatpak/Snap. Disponibiliza um modo básico com limpeza padrão e um modo avançado para cada secção.

Il Pulitore di Sistema di Soplos esamina il sistema per liberare spazio su disco: cache APT, vecchi kernel, driver e firmware inutilizzati, lingue non utilizzate, pacchetti orfani, log, file temporanei e residui Flatpak/Snap. Include un programma base per una pulizia rapida e uno avanzato per un controllo totale.

Curățare Sistem Soplos scanează sistemul pentru recuperarea spațiului pe disc: cache APT, kerneluri vechi, drivere și firmware nefolosite, pachete orfane, jurnale, fișiere temporare și reziduuri Flatpak/Snap. Include un mod de bază cu o curățare standard și un mod avansat complet.

Очистка системы Soplos сканирует систему для освобождения места на диске: кэш APT, старые ядра, неиспользуемые драйверы и прошивки, неиспользуемые языки, потерянные пакеты, журналы, временные файлы и остатки Flatpak/Snap с предварительным просмотром. Включает базовый режим для очистки в один клик и расширенный режим.

description.p: First stable release.

After cleaning drivers or firmware, the initramfs of every kernel is rebuilt with update-initramfs, which also copies it to the EFI partition when the system boots with systemd-boot. Before, only the running kernel was rebuilt.

Program leftovers lists only the folders whose program the system proves is gone: the data of a Flatpak or a snap that is not installed, and a folder with exactly the name of a removed package when nothing installed has that name. Nothing is guessed any more, and nothing comes selected. The tracker service of 3.0.1-beta is removed, and upgrading deletes the file it kept. Orphaned packages no longer offers the package that holds the signing key of a repository that is still configured. The scrollbar of the sidebar no longer covers its rows, and the About dialog shows the full package version.

New page, Program leftovers: the folders that uninstalled programs left in the home folder, found by working out which program made each of them and whether it is still installed. What is cleaned goes to the Trash. A small service records which program creates each folder.
The button that cleans the selection stays fixed at the bottom of the window, and the manual page describes the Snapshots and Disk space pages.
The window no longer has the frame of the system: it is a card with rounded corners and its own minimize, maximize and close buttons.
New application icon, new hero image and new screenshots, taken with the interface in English.

Snapshots: the list is read when the page opens, with a single password. Timeshift snapshots in BTRFS mode now show their size when the BTRFS quotas are on, and a dash instead of 0 B when the size cannot be told.

New Disk space page, in a new Analysis group: where the space goes, folder by folder, for your user or the whole system, with the option to read as administrator. It only shows; nothing is deleted from there.
Documentation: every package folder under /usr/share/doc is listed, whatever its size, so the user chooses what goes. Before, only the ones over 1 MB were.
Long paths no longer widen the table past the window.
New Snapshots category: lists, deletes and makes the restore points of Timeshift (rsync and BTRFS) and Snapper, always keeping the newest one of each.
The window follows the light or dark theme of the desktop (Xfce, Plasma and GNOME), and the button of the sidebar still lets you choose.
Wider sidebar whose scroll bar no longer sits on the figures, and the type errors of the project fixed.
Full 8-language internationalization across desktop launchers and AppStream metadata.
Added Unix manual page documentation (soplos-sys-cleaner.1) installed to /usr/share/man/man1/.
Updated Debian packaging and application documentation.
Orphaned packages, every kind of installed app in one list with a reinstall script, animated health rings, and alerts that reach GNOME.

ul.li: New Orphaned packages page, with a dry run before removing
New Residual configuration page, to purge packages that were removed but left their configuration
Installed apps now lists APT, Flatpak, Snap and AppImage apps, and exports a script that installs them again after a format
APT package cache listed file by file
The health rings and the weekly chart animate from zero to their values
Search box with a clear button, and a toolbar that stays in place while scrolling
Alerts and the test notification are shown on GNOME
Footer of the basic program with desktop, display protocol and version
The Languages page lists the protected languages again on systems cleaned with localepurge
The storage card no longer lists installed snaps as disks
The keyboard shortcuts keep working after the About dialog (F1) has been opened
Login screens, boot loaders and base packages are never purged, and the login screen link and the GRUB defaults are restored if a cleanup removes them
Turning the alerts off clears their settings
The user cache cleanup no longer deletes folders with live state, such as the input method socket

description.p: A basic program for a one-click standard cleanup, new kernels, drivers, firmware, languages and documentation pages, a safer privileged helper and a richer history.

ul.li: New basic program with a health ring and a single standard cleanup, next to the advanced one in the same package
New Kernels, Drivers, Firmware, Languages and Documentation pages, with risk labels and a dry run before removing packages
Privileged operations are now named and validated again as root, with one password prompt per batch
Search and sortable columns on every page, and an export of the installed apps list
Journal retention by time or by size
History receipts with kind, duration, command and result, and CSV export
Optional alerts by time or by size, chosen by the user; notification only, never cleans by itself
Keyboard shortcuts

description.p: First version of Soplos Sys Cleaner on Tauri 2, with a Rust backend and a Svelte frontend, replacing the Python 3 and GTK3 application.
